SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM service_requests
        WHERE requester_email = $1
          AND normalized_title = $2
    ) AS is_duplicate,

    (
        SELECT request_id
        FROM service_requests
        WHERE requester_email = $1
          AND normalized_title = $2
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS existing_request_id;

INSERT INTO service_requests (
    request_id,
    requester_name,
    requester_email,
    department,
    title,
    normalized_title,
    description,
    declared_priority,
    status,
    created_at,
    due_at
)
VALUES (
    'REQ-' ||
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::TEXT ||
    '-' ||
    LPAD(
        nextval('service_request_number_seq')::TEXT,
        6,
        '0'
    ),

    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7,
    'Open',
    $8::timestamptz,
    $9::timestamptz
)
RETURNING
    id,
    request_id,
    created_at,
    due_at;

INSERT INTO request_events (
    request_id,
    event_type,
    new_status,
    metadata
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    'REQUEST_CREATED',
    'Open',
    $2::jsonb
)
RETURNING
    id,
    request_id,
    event_type,
    created_at;

WITH inserted_request AS (
    INSERT INTO service_requests (
        request_id,
        requester_name,
        requester_email,
        department,
        title,
        normalized_title,
        description,
        declared_priority,
        status,
        created_at,
        due_at
    )
    VALUES (
        'REQ-' ||
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::TEXT ||
        '-' ||
        LPAD(
            nextval('service_request_number_seq')::TEXT,
            6,
            '0'
        ),
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        'Open',
        $8::timestamptz,
        $9::timestamptz
    )
    RETURNING
        request_id,
        requester_name,
        requester_email,
        department,
        title,
        declared_priority,
        status,
        created_at,
        due_at
),
audit_event AS (
    INSERT INTO request_events (
        request_id,
        event_type,
        new_status,
        metadata
    )
    SELECT
        request_id,
        'REQUEST_CREATED',
        status,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'requester_email', requester_email,
            'department', department,
            'priority', declared_priority,
            'title', title
        )
    FROM inserted_request
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    r.request_id,
    r.status,
    r.created_at,
    r.due_at
FROM inserted_request r;
